results.failure_scope: All 26 unsuccessful tests share the same short-versus-canonical temporary-path exception.

root_cause: CycleTests.setUp retains the Windows 8.3 temporary-directory alias, while dataset_reference resolves the manifest to the long path. pathlib.relative_to then sees different lexical parents for the same physical directory.

proposed_fix.scope: Test fixture normalization only; main() already resolves the real state directory.

next_verification: Apply after the actual arena and independent audit; rerun all 37 cycle unit tests, then run required Windows/Linux CI on the final fix commit. No new match is required for this fixture-only change if the diff remains exactly as described.
log_policy: Compact relevant exception only; temporary-directory random names replaced with <TEST_TEMP>; no authentication or setup logs.
